title: Discover Japan | From Tokyo Skylines to Osaka Sights
highlights: Explore Tokyo and Osaka on a tour that takes you through the best of both cities, from iconic landmarks to hidden gems, giving you a true feel of Japan’s culture.
Discover Roppongi, Tokyo’s lively district lined with cafes, shops and art, where you can explore everything from upscale malls to local galleries.
Ride the Hakone Ropeway and enjoy incredible views of Lake Ashi, volcanic valleys, and Mt. Fuji.
Visit the Tokyo Imperial Palace and walk through its beautiful East Gardens, a peaceful spot that’s been the heart of Japan’s royal family for centuries.
Admire Tokyo Tower, originally modeled after Paris' Eiffel Tower, and learn about its role in Japan's communication and broadcasting history.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon arrival at the Narita International Airport, get transferred to the hotel. Check in & enjoy your day at leisure. You can shop at Ginza, Tokyo's upscale shopping district or witness traditional performances at the Samurai Theater. In the evening, you can enjoy a stroll through Yoyogi Park or visit Shibuya Crossing, one of the busiest intersections in the world, among several other iconic attractions.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the pick-up point- LOVE Sculpture & board the transfer for Tokyo city tour. Visit Meiji Jingu Shrine, a peaceful Shinto sanctuary surrounded by lush forests. Then, stop at Imperial Palace, the heart of Japan's monarchy. Also, explore Senso Ji Temple in Asakusa, Tokyo's oldest temple, & futuristic Odaiba District, home to various shopping & entertainment options. After the tour, get driven to 1-chōme-7-2 Nishishinjuku, Shinjuku City & from there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Full Day Tokyo City Tour by Bus - From LOVE Statue with Lunch

days.title: Excursion To Mount Fuji & Hakone
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Mt. Fuji & Hakone. Start by heading to Shinjuku LoveGiulio Paolini Sculpture: "Kaleidoscorpio" & from there board the transfer to Mt. Fuji's 5th Station, offering views of Fuji Five Lakes. After that, enjoy a scenic Hakone ropeway ride offering views of Lake Ashi. Continue your journey to Owakudani Valley, known for its volcanic activity & hot springs. Later, get transferred to Odawara Station to board bullet train to Tokyo. Upon arriving, reach the hotel on your own.

Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel in Tokyo and head to Tokyo station on your own to board the Shinkansen bullet train to Osaka (tickets included). Upon arrival, reach the hotel on your own and check in. Later, you can explore the city at your leisure. You can see places like Osaka Castle, known for its rich Japanese history or explore famous shopping spots like Den Den Town. You can explore other attractions & later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Osaka Museum Of Housing And Living
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Day Trip to Kyoto and Nara
days.desc: Head to the pick-up point, Namba Ocat Building, on your own to board your transfer for the day trip to Kyoto and Nara. Start by visiting Kinkaku-ji, the Golden Pavilion, famous for its dazzling gold-leafed exterior. Then, explore Arashiyama, known for its bamboo groves, where you can walk through towering bamboo stalks & click stunning photos. End your tour at Nara Park & then, get transferred to the drop-off point. From there, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full-Day Tour to Kyoto & Nara - Osaka Namba Dep/Buffet Lunch

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Today, head to the meeting point-Osaka Tourist Information Center on your own. Wander through the Shinsekai & Hozenji Yokocho streets, filled with local eateries. Next, visit the historic Hozenji Temple & later, explore the Dotonbori District, a popular area for its vibrant signage and street food options like takoyaki and okonomiyaki. The tour ends at Ebisu Bridge, a well-known spot offering views of Dotonbori. After that, you can explore Osaka on your own, visiting various sites.

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, enjoy the day exploring Osaka at your own pace. You can visit the Miraiza Osaka-jo, a historic commercial complex originally built in 1931 as the headquarters of the Imperial Japanese Army’s Fourth Division. You can also stroll through the streets of Shinsekai and visit the Hokoku Shrine. In the evening, you can head to Abeno Harukas, a towering 300-meter skyscraper, and marvel at the breathtaking cityscape from its observation deck, among several other attraction points.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, pack your bags full of memorable adventures. Check out of the hotel, and get transferred to Kansai International Airport, where your trip comes to an end.
